Law, Jurisdiction and Arbitration: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. Any dispute, controversy or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be settled by arbitration in accordance with the provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, or any statutory amendments thereof and shall be referred to a Sole Arbitrator nominated by the Lender. The arbitration shall be held at Mumbai and the proceedings shall be in English. The award of the Sole Arbitrator shall be final and binding on the parties.
